hooks.text: 魔理沙沉迷“Kappachinko”输光财产并欠灵梦恶意贷款，被迫参加幻想乡魔法道具战还债。
hooks.excerpt: Marisa had sold all her magical items to raise money for 'Kappachinko'... Unfortunately she lost everything in it! Driven by addiction, Marisa had stolen all across Gensokyo, even took on a malicious loan from Reimu! With no other choice, she's forced to join the magical item battles that was trending in Gensokyo, hoping to earn enough to repay her debts and escape from Reimu's relentless pursuit…
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 从158件道具和69种技能中组合专属构筑，属性与效果可产生开发者也未预设的新组合。
hooks.excerpt: The game features a total of 158 items and 69 skills, each with its own unique attributes and effects. Unleash your creativity and combine them into powerful constructs! You might even discover new combinations that the dev team never imagined.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 一局分十天、每天四个时段；白天处理事件与强化，夜市则挑选东方角色进行挑战。
hooks.excerpt: Each game is divided into 10 days , with each day split into 4 moments. In the daytime, You will encounter various events, where you can purchase items, learn skills, gain exp, fight random enemies, or even change the effect of an item! At the end of each day, you will visit the night market and meet other Touhou charaters who specialize in different weapons (we won't spoil who they are, but let's just say you might run into Koishi, Remilia or Reisen). Choose who you want to talk to, then challenge and defeat them!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
